summary: Female hiker separated from her group near the Cal Wood cottage (2282 County Rd 87, Jamestown area); group reported her missing ~3:30 p.m. A local resident found her quickly in the 1200 block of County Rd 87J.
location: Cal Wood / 1200 block of County Rd 87J, near Jamestown
notes: Date 2010-06-27 weekday-verified: blotter item states "Sunday, June 27" and 2010-06-27 was Sunday.
